source: RFC 0007 §5.7 (maintainer decision 2026-11-21, the control-plane host's replicas and embedders; what can be computed is not configured; control-server-design §0.6)
statement: Every control-plane instance runs the maintenance passes (reclaiming revisions, closing shadow windows, reconciling the app list and the staged list), kept apart by their leases: any number of instances over one store run each pass once per interval, one at a time. There is no switch that turns them off, so no deployment can be configured in which none runs.
guards: spring-boot:ControlServicePortTest#the maintenance passes run on every host that has the control plane, and no property turns them off
spring-boot:UnknownPropertiesTest#a switch that was removed before it was released is not a property
control:ControlMaintenanceTest#shadow windows are closed by whoever holds the lease, which a pass releases
